<a id="architecture"></a>

## Architecture

Binding doctrine: .agents-skills-port/pij-team/TENETS.md (repo-local copy); repo AGENTS.md; Plan109 graded findings (historical RPC mechanics superseded, consent/order/receipt lessons applicable). PM authors all plan/guide changes. Three coders with disjoint fences own daemon, native extension, and installation/proof harness. PM freezes wire and file-layout contracts before fan-out; same-file mutation prohibited.

Frozen architecture:
1. User extension source .copilot/extensions/pij/extension.mjs; split runtime-neutral state/helpers into adjacent store.mjs only when it removes test/runtime coupling. SDK import is top-level @github/copilot-sdk/extension and resolved by Copilot, never a new npm dependency. No giant inline bundle or fs polling bridge. Use daemon blocking inbox wait as in PoC, abortable and reconnectable.
2. Add optional registration capability native_extension_delivery:boolean (default false) and persisted SeatDescriptor representation; only verified live Copilot extension registration asserts true. PID+proc_start is runtime truth, not extension child PID guessed as host; require parent context supplied by native runtime or a verified ancestor. Preserve harness_session and exact pane. Same-incarnation reconnect preserves correct capability; new incarnation/revive clears it until attested. Registration response changes additive. Any claimed native-session mismatch refuses rather than hijacks an existing seat.
3. Copilot becomes extension-only: arrival queues, pointer/drain excludes Copilot; pre-attach/new unsupported seat remains pending or explicit unavailable. A true capability permits native claim; false cannot claim as supported native delivery. No path types/pastes a Copilot message/control command, even on transient extension failure. Existing OMP/Pi behavior unchanged. Never hide pane metadata to force paneless route. Historical RPC migration scripts untouched; remove runtime rpc_port_intent/allocator/flags and obsolete Copilot-only paths, using forward migration if removing persisted column.
4. Human input consent lives in existing InteractionGate. Native Copilot claims with panes require the current fresh permission verdict at handoff; held claims stay durable and wake when permission changes or on bounded retry cadence. No policy/timing edits in crates/core/src/delivery.rs or crates/harnesses/src/interaction.rs (plan136 owns); expose/use existing API, request PM decision if insufficient. Pi/OMP exemption unchanged. Failed sensor must not count as permission.
5. Native receive lifecycle: one consumer/session, one claim at a time, capture Pij msg_id + native returned messageId; durable acceptance record before ack; repeated Pij delivery consults that record and native event/history evidence rather than blind reinjection. Ack after native acceptance, not after mere file read, never label model completion. Native idle/assistant evidence is separate. Abort loop and close handles on extension/session change. Reconnect refreshes bearer key; non-JSON HTTP failures keep status/body diagnostic. Avoid persistently replaying malformed or unsupported commands. Ambiguous crash boundary produces honest failure/held diagnostic unless current native events prove acceptance; no universal exactly-once claim.
6. Outgoing API: native tool pij_send({to:string,message:string}) calls authenticated Pij /v1/send with immutable registered seat as from and newly minted msg_id; returns receipt with acceptance grade. Do not install an automatic assistant-response forwarding loop. Regular Pij CLI in pane must resolve current seat; for paneless users native tool is supported outgoing path. Do not change global process identity or mutate parent environment. Existing identity projections may gain additive native-session metadata only.
7. Installation extends guarded harness/scripts/link-global.ts + just link/install/doctor conventions. Canonical checkout owns global artifact; COPILOT_HOME overrides default ~/.copilot; expected destination extensions/pij/extension.mjs and any adjacent module links. Preserve foreign symlinks/real files; merge experimental:true into settings.json without deleting unknowns; do not copy PoC hooks/provider settings. Disabled extension mode remains explicit opt-out with actionable diagnostic, not coerced session mutation. Isolated homes supported for tests and real witnesses without touching developer's real settings.
8. Commands: never invoke tmux to implement Copilot compact/new/reload. Use SDK history.compact if actual runtime capability can be proven; unsupported command returns explicit named refusal before irreversible consume. No sending '/compact' as model text. Native user-driven new/resume/reload keeps session lifecycle coherent; no forced /clear workaround.

Scope exclusions: current plan136 vocabulary/interaction implementations and the .pi/extensions/pij extension-side hold queue, unrelated gates, installed binaries, machine global configuration, governance ledger, other stream code. Shared crates/daemon/src/delivery/mod.rs extension-stream match is notified at implementation and takes baton at COMPOSITION only. Plan135 additive register response; do not revert its contracts at convergence.

<a id="risks"></a>

## Risks

| id | text |
| --- | --- |
| identity | Native child and host PIDs differ. Bind only verified actual host incarnation/session, and never steal another pane/seat. |
| ownership | Generic drain may race extension. Assert both initial and scheduled paths never submit tmux for Copilot and run pane-backed proof. |
| durability | Native accepted before daemon ack is ambiguous under crash. Durable local acceptance plus native event/history evidence; never promise universal exactly-once without proof. |
| consent | RPC/native transport can start a turn while human composing. Reuse current InteractionGate; no vocabulary/timing edits owned by136. |
| install | Global edits are risky. Use isolated homes for tests; canonical-main ownership and preservation checks; no real rollout in worktree. |
| baseline | Before code: typecheck passed, file-watch-notify smoke failed. Final deliverable must disclose full gate red if still present; no suppression. |
